text:
I can only see the meal before eating, so the leftover figure is a guess. These are my estimates for each item served:

- Noodles with meat: about 350 kcal, roughly 12 g protein, 45 g carbs and 13 g fat.
- Mixed vegetables: about 70 kcal, 3 g protein, 14 g carbs and 1 g fat.
- Fruit (melon and watermelon): about 70 kcal, 1 g protein, 17 g carbs and 0 g fat.
- Salad greens: about 25 kcal, 1 g protein, 4 g carbs and 0 g fat.
- Water: 0 kcal.

That gives about 515 kcal served. I assumed about 60 kcal would be left over, so the person would eat about 455 kcal. I scaled the macros down to match that: about 15 g protein, 72 g carbs and 13 g fat.
